menahem_1996.description: Conforting, the son of Gadi, and successor of Shallum, king of Israel, whom he slew. After a reign of about ten years (B.C. 771-760) he died, leaving the throne to his son Pekahiah. His reign was one of cruelty and oppression (2 Kings 15:14-22). During his reign, Pul (q.v.), king of Assyria, came with a powerful force…

tilgath-pilneser_2376.name: Tilgath-pilneser
tilgath-pilneser_2376.description: An Assyrian king. It has been a question whether he was identical with Tiglath-pileser III. (q.v.), or was his predecessor. The weight of evidence is certainly in favour of their identity. Pul was the throne-name he bore in Babylonia as king of Babylon, and Tiglath-pileser the throne-name he bore as king of Assyria.…

pekahiah_2300.name: Pekahiah
pekahiah_2300.description: The Lord opened his eyes, the son and successor of Menahem on the throne of Israel. He was murdered in the royal palace of Samaria by Pekah, one of the captains of his army (2 Kings 15:23-26), after a reign of two years (B.C. 761-759). He “did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.”

pekah_2299.name: Pekah
pekah_2299.description: Open-eyed, the son of Remaliah a captain in the army of Pekahiah, king of Israel, whom he slew, with the aid of a band of Gileadites, and succeeded (B.C. 758) on the throne (2 Kings 15:25). Seventeen years after this he entered into an alliance with Rezin, king of Syria, and took part with him in besieging Jerusalem…

remaliah_2420.name: Remaliah
remaliah_2420.description: Adorned by the Lord, the father of Pekah, who conspired successfully against Pekahiah (2 Kings 15:25, 27, 30, 32, 37; Isa. 7:1, 4, 5, 9; 8:6).

arieh_301.name: Arieh
arieh_301.description: The lion, the name of one of the body-guard slain with Pekahiah at Samaria (2 Kings 15:25) by the conspirator Pekah.

hoshea_1559.name: Hoshea
hoshea_1559.description: The last king of Israel. He conspired against and slew his predecessor, Pekah (Isa. 7:16), but did not ascend the throne till after an interregnum of warfare of eight years (2 Kings 17:1, 2). Soon after this he submitted to Shalmaneser, the Assyrian king, who a second time invaded the land to punish Hoshea, because of…

elah_1046.name: Elah
elah_1046.description: The father of Hoshea, the last king of Israel (2 Kings 15:30; 17:1).

jerushah_882.name: Jerushah
jerushah_882.description: Possession, or possessed; i.e., “by a husband”, the wife of Uzziah, and mother of king Jotham (2 Kings 15:33).

zadok_2974.name: Zadok
zadok_2974.description: The father of Jerusha, who was wife of King Uzziah, and mother of King Jotham (2 Kings 15:33; 2 Chr. 27:1).

rezin_2435.name: Rezin
rezin_2435.description: Firm; a prince, a king of Syria, who joined Pekah (q.v.) in an invasion of the kingdom of Judah (2 Kings 15:37; 16:5-9; Isa. 7:1-8). Ahaz induced Tiglath-pileser III. to attack Damascus, and this caused Rezin to withdraw for the purpose of defending his own kingdom. Damascus was taken, and Rezin was slain in battle by…

ahaz_118.name: Ahaz
ahaz_118.description: The son and successor of Jotham, king of Judah (2 Kings 16; Isa. 7-9; 2 Chr. 28). He gave himself up to a life of wickedness and idolatry. Notwithstanding the remonstrances and warnings of Isaiah, Hosea, and Micah, he appealed for help against Rezin, king of Damascus, and Pekah, king of Israel, who threatened…

urijah_2903.name: Urijah
urijah_2903.description: A high priest in the time of Ahaz (2 Kings 16:10-16), at whose bidding he constructed an idolatrous altar like one the king had seen at Damascus, to be set up instead of the brazen altar.

hezekiah_1512.name: Hezekiah
hezekiah_1512.description: Son of Ahaz (2 Kings 18:1; 2 Chr. 29:1), whom he succeeded on the throne of the kingdom of Judah. He reigned twenty-nine years (B.C. 726-697). The history of this king is contained in 2 Kings 18:20, Isa. 36-39, and 2 Chr. 29-32. He is spoken of as a great and good king. In public life he followed the example of his…

shalmaneser_2529.name: Shalmaneser
shalmaneser_2529.description: An Assyrian king (Hos. 10:14), identified with Shalmaneser II. (Sayce) or IV. (Lenormant), the successor of Pul on the throne of Assyria (B.C. 728). He made war against Hoshea, the king of Israel, whom he subdued and compelled to pay an annual tribute. Hoshea, however, soon after rebelled against his Assyrian…

so_2760.name: So
so_2760.description: (Nubian, Sabako), an Ethiopian king who brought Egypt under his sway. He was bribed by Hoshea to help him against the Assyrian monarch Shalmaneser (2 Kings 17:4). This was a return to the policy that had been successful in the reign of Jeroboam I.

adrammelech_103.name: Adrammelech
adrammelech_103.description: An idol; a form of the sun-god worshipped by the inhabitants of Sepharvaim (2 Kings 17:31), and brought by the Sepharvite colonists into Samaria.

anammelech_254.name: Anammelech
anammelech_254.description: One of the gods worshipped by the people of Sepharvaim, who colonized Samaria (2 Kings 17:31). The name means “Anu is king.” It was a female deity representing the moon, as Adrammelech (q.v.) was the male representing the sun.

abijah_14.name: Abijah
abijah_14.description: The daughter of Zechariah (2 Chr. 29:1; comp. Isa. 8:2), and afterwards the wife of Ahaz. She is also called Abi (2 Kings 18:2).

zechariah_2970.name: Zechariah
zechariah_2970.description: The father of Abijah, who was the mother of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:1).

sennacherib_2489.name: Sennacherib
sennacherib_2489.description: Sin (the god) sends many brothers, son of Sargon, whom he succeeded on the throne of Assyria (B.C. 705), in the 23rd year of Hezekiah. “Like the Persian Xerxes, he was weak and vainglorious, cowardly under reverse, and cruel and boastful in success.” He first set himself to break up the powerful combination of princes…

tartan_2830.name: Tartan
tartan_2830.description: One of Sennacherib’s messengers to Hezekiah (2 Kings 18:17).

rabsaris_2382.name: Rabsaris
rabsaris_2382.description: Chief of the Heads, one of the three officers whom Sennacherib sent from Lachish with a threatening message to Jerusalem (2 Kings 18:17; Jer. 39:3, 13).

rabshakeh_2384.name: Rabshakeh
rabshakeh_2384.description: Chief of the princes, the name given to the chief cup-bearer or the vizier of the Assyrian court; one of Sennacherib’s messengers to Hezekiah. See the speech he delivered, in the Hebrew language, in the hearing of all the people, as he stood near the wall on the north side of the city (2 Kings 18:17-37). He and the…

eliakim_1084.name: Eliakim
eliakim_1084.description: The son of Hilkiah, who was sent to receive the message of the invading Assyrians and report it to Isaiah (2 Kings 18:18; 19:2; Isa. 36:3; 37:2). In his office as governor of the palace of Hezekiah he succeeded Shebna (Isa. 22:15-25). He was a good man (Isa. 22:20; 2 Kings 18:37), and had a splendid and honourable…

shebna_2577.name: Shebna
shebna_2577.description: Tender youth, “treasurer” over the house in the reign of Hezekiah, i.e., comptroller or governor of the palace. On account of his pride he was ejected from his office, and Eliakim was promoted to it (Isa. 22:15-25). He appears to have been the leader of the party who favoured an alliance with Egypt against Assyria. It…

joah_1621.name: Joah
joah_1621.description: The son of Asaph, and “recorder” (q.v.) or chronicler to King Hezekiah (2 Kings 18:18, 26, 37).

asaph_329.name: Asaph
asaph_329.description: The “recorder” in the time of Hezekiah (2 Kings 18:18, 37).

pharaoh_2333.name: Pharaoh
pharaoh_2333.description: Pharaoh, in whom Hezekiah put his trust in his war against Sennacherib (2 Kings 18:21).

isaiah_617.name: Isaiah
isaiah_617.description: The son of Amoz (Isa. 1:1; 2:1), who was apparently a man of humble rank. His wife was called “the prophetess” (8:3), either because she was endowed with the prophetic gift, like Deborah (Judg. 4:4) and Huldah (2 Kings 22:14-20), or simply because she was the wife of “the prophet” (Isa. 38:1). He had two sons, who…

amoz_240.name: Amoz
amoz_240.description: Strong, the father of the prophet Isaiah (2 Kings 19:2, 20; 20:1; Isa. 1:1; 2:1). As to his personal history little is positively known. He is supposed by some to have been the “man of God” spoken of in 2 Chr. 25:7, 8.

tirhakah_2865.name: Tirhakah
tirhakah_2865.description: The last king of Egypt of the Ethiopian (the fifteenth) dynasty. He was the brother-in-law of So (q.v.). He probably ascended the throne about B.C. 692, having been previously king of Ethiopia (2 Kings 19:9; Isa. 37:9), which with Egypt now formed one nation. He was a great warrior, and but little is known of him. The…

adrammelech_104.name: Adrammelech
adrammelech_104.description: A son of Sennacherib, king of Assyria (2 Kings 19:37; Isa. 37:38).

sharezer_2559.name: Sharezer
sharezer_2559.description: (god) protect the king!, a son of Sennacherib, king of Assyria. He and his brother Adrammelech murdered their father, and then fled into the land of Armenia (2 Kings 19:37).

baladan_594.name: Baladan
baladan_594.description: He has given a son, the father of the Babylonian king (2 Kings 20:12; Isa. 39:1) Merodach-baladan (q.v.).

manasseh_1930.name: Manasseh (son of Hezekiah)
manasseh_1930.description: The elder of the two sons of Joseph. He and his brother Ephraim were afterwards adopted by Jacob as his own sons (48:1). There is an account of his marriage to a Syrian (1 Chr. 7:14); and the only thing afterwards recorded of him is, that his grandchildren were “brought up upon Joseph’s knees” (Gen. 50:23; R.V., “born…

amon_236.name: Amon
amon_236.description:
The son of Manasseh, and fourteenth king of Judah. He restored idolatry, and set up the images which his father had cast down. Zephaniah (1:4; 3:4, 11) refers to the moral depravity prevailing in this king’s reign.

 He was assassinated (2 Kings 21:18-26: 2 Chr. 33:20-25) by his own servants, who conspired against…

meshullemeth_2040.name: Meshullemeth
meshullemeth_2040.description: Friend, the wife of Manasseh, and the mother of Amon (2 Kings 21:19), Kings of Judah.

haruz_1425.name: Haruz
haruz_1425.description: Eager, the father of Meshullemeth, the wife of king Manasseh (2 Kings 21:19) and mother of king Amon.

shaphan_2550.name: Shaphan
shaphan_2550.description: A coney, a scribe or secretary of king Josiah (2 Kings 22:3-7). He consulted Huldah concerning the newly-discovered copy of the law which was delivered to him by Hilkiah the priest (8-14). His grandson Gedaliah was governor of Judea (25:22).

meshullam_2020.name: Meshullam
meshullam_2020.description: Grandfather of Shaphan, “the scribe,” in the reign of Josiah (2 Kings 22:3).

hilkiah_1524.name: Hilkiah
hilkiah_1524.description: The high priest in the reign of Josiah (1 Chr. 6:13; Ezra 7:1). To him and his deputy (2 Kings 23:5), along with the ordinary priests and the Levites who had charge of the gates, was entrusted the purification of the temple in Jerusalem. While this was in progress, he discovered in some hidden corner of the building a…

ahikam_141.name: Ahikam
ahikam_141.description: Brother of support = helper, one of the five whom Josiah sent to consult the prophetess Huldah in connection with the discovery of the book of the law (2 Kings 22:12-14; 2 Chr. 34:20). He was the son of Shaphan, the royal secretary, and the father of Gedaliah, governor of Judea after the destruction of Jerusalem by…

achbor_63.name: Achbor
achbor_63.description: The son of Micah, one of those whom Josiah sent to the prophetess Huldah to ascertain from her the meaning of the recently discovered book of the law (2 Chr. 34:20). He is called Achbor in 2 Kings 22:12.

asahiah_324.name: Asahiah
asahiah_324.description: The son of Amoz (Isa. 1:1; 2:1), who was apparently a man of humble rank. His wife was called “the prophetess” (8:3), either because she was endowed with the prophetic gift, like Deborah (Judg. 4:4) and Huldah (2 Kings 22:14-20), or simply because she was the wife of “the prophet” (Isa. 38:1). He had two sons, who…

huldah_1567.name: Huldah
huldah_1567.description: Weasel, a prophetess; the wife of Shallum. She was consulted regarding the “book of the law” discovered by the high priest Hilkiah (2 Kings 22:14-20; 2 Chr. 34:22-28). She resided in that part of Jerusalem called the Mishneh (A.V., “the college;” R.V., “the second quarter”), supposed by some to be the suburb between…

shallum_2515.name: Shallum
shallum_2515.description: Keeper of the temple vestments in the reign of Josiah (2 Kings 22:14).

hasrah_1414.name: Hasrah
hasrah_1414.description: Poverty, “keeper of the wardrobe,” i.e., of the sacerdotal vestments (2 Chr. 34:22); called Harhas 2 Kings 22:14. He was husband of the prophetess Huldah.

jehoahaz_2516.name: Jehoahaz
jehoahaz_2516.description: A son of king Josiah (1 Chr. 3:15; Jer. 22:11), who was elected to succeed his father on the throne, although he was two years younger than his brother Eliakim. He assumed the crown under the name of Jehoahaz (q.v.). He did not imitate the example of his father (2 Kings 23:32), but was “a young lion, and it learned to…

hamutal_1368.name: Hamutal
hamutal_1368.description: Kinsman of the dew, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah, wife of king Josiah, and mother of king Jehoahaz (2 Kings 23:31), also of king Zedekiah (2 Kings 24:18).

jeremiah_848.name: Jeremiah
jeremiah_848.description: The father of Hamutal (2 Kings 23:31), the wife of Josiah.

jehoiakim_1085.name: Jehoiakim
jehoiakim_1085.description:
He whom Jehovah has set up, the second son of Josiah, and eighteenth king of Judah, which he ruled over for eleven years (B.C. 610-599). His original name was Eliakim (q.v.).

 On the death of his father his younger brother Jehoahaz (=Shallum, Jer. 22:11), who favoured the Chaldeans against the Egyptians, was made…

zebudah_3000.name: Zebudah
zebudah_3000.description: Given, the wife of Josiah and mother of Jehoiakim (2 Kings 23:36).

pedaiah_2292.name: Pedaiah
pedaiah_2292.description: The father of Zebudah, who was the wife of Josiah and mother of king Jehoiakim (2 Kings 23:36).

nebuchadnezzar_2167.name: Nebuchadnezzar
nebuchadnezzar_2167.description: In the Babylonian orthography Nabu-kudur-uzur, which means “Nebo, protect the crown!” or the “frontiers.” In an inscription he styles himself “Nebo’s favourite.” He was the son and successor of Nabopolassar, who delivered Babylon from its dependence on Assyria and laid Nineveh in ruins. He was the greatest and most…

jehoiachin_791.name: Jehoiachin
jehoiachin_791.description: Succeeded his father Jehoiakin (B.C. 599) when only eight years of age, and reigned for one hundred days (2 Chr. 36:9). He is also called Jeconiah (Jer. 24:1; 27:20, etc.), and Coniah (22:24; 37:1). He was succeeded by his uncle, Mattaniah = Zedekiah (q.v.). He was the last direct heir to the Jewish crown. He was…

nehushta_2174.name: Nehushta
nehushta_2174.description: Copper, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, and the wife of Jehoiakin (2 Kings 24:8), king of Judah.

zedekiah_1950.name: Zedekiah
zedekiah_1950.description: The last king of Judah. He was the third son of Josiah, and his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah, and hence he was the brother of Jehoahaz (2 Kings 23:31; 24:17, 18). His original name was Mattaniah; but when Nebuchadnezzar placed him on the throne as the successor to Jehoiachin he changed…

nebuzar-adan_2169.name: Nebuzar-adan
nebuzar-adan_2169.description: “the captain of the guard,” in rank next to the king, who appears prominent in directing affairs at the capture of Jerusalem (2 Kings 25:8-20; Jer. 39:11; 40:2-5). He showed kindness toward Jeremiah, as commanded by Nebuchadnezzar (40:1). Five years after this he again came to Jerusalem and carried captive seven…

zephaniah_3039.name: Zephaniah
zephaniah_3039.description: The son of Maaseiah, the “second priest” in the reign of Zedekiah, often mentioned in Jeremiah as having been sent from the king to inquire (Jer. 21:1) regarding the coming woes which he had denounced, and to entreat the prophet’s intercession that the judgment threatened might be averted (Jer. 29:25, 26, 29; 37:3;…

gedaliah_1287.name: Gedaliah
gedaliah_1287.description: The son of Ahikam, and grandson of Shaphan, secretary of king Josiah (Jer. 26:24). After the destruction of Jerusalem (see ZEDEKIAH), Nebuchadnezzar left him to govern the country as tributary to him (2 Kings 25:22; Jer. 40:5; 52:16). Ishmael, however, at the head of a party of the royal family, “Jewish…

ishmael_631.name: Ishmael
ishmael_631.description: The son of Nethaniah, “of the seed royal” (Jer. 40:8, 15). He plotted against Gedaliah, and treacherously put him and others to death. He carried off many captives, “and departed to go over to the Ammonites.”

johanan_1666.name: Johanan
johanan_1666.description: Son of Careah, one of the Jewish chiefs who rallied round Gedaliah, whom Nebuchadnezzar had made governor in Jerusalem (2 Kings 25:23; Jer. 40:8). He warned Gedaliah of the plans of Ishmael against him, a warning which was unheeded (Jer. 40:13, 16). He afterwards pursued the murderer of the governor, and rescued the…

kareah_919.name: Kareah
kareah_919.description: Bald, the father of Johanan and Jonathan, who for a time were loyal to Gedaliah, the Babylonian governor of Jerusalem (Jer. 40:8, 13, 15, 16).

tanhumeth_2824.name: Tanhumeth
tanhumeth_2824.description: Consolation, a Netophathite; one of the captains who supported Gedaliah (2 Kings 25:23; Jer. 40:8).

jezaniah_667.name: Jezaniah
jezaniah_667.description: A Maachathite (2 Kings 25:23; Jer. 40:8; 42:1). He is also called Azariah (Jer. 43:2).

evil-merodach_1233.name: Evil-merodach
evil-merodach_1233.description: Merodach’s man, the son and successor of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon (2 Kings 25:27; Jer. 52:31, 34). He seems to have reigned but two years (B.C. 562-560). Influenced probably by Daniel, he showed kindness to Jehoiachin, who had been a prisoner in Babylon for thirty-seven years. He released him, and “spoke kindly…

heman_1489.name: Heman
heman_1489.description: 1 Kings 4:31; 1 Chr. 2:6, a son of Zerah, noted for his wisdom.

calcol_536.name: Calcol
calcol_536.description: (1 Chr. 2:6), sustenance, the same probably as Chalcol (1 Kings 4:31), one of the four sages whom Solomon excelled in wisdom; for “he was wiser than all men.”

azariah_376.name: Azariah
azariah_376.description: Son of Ethan, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 2:8).

jerahmeel_843.name: Jerahmeel
jerahmeel_843.description: The son of Hezron, the brother of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:9, 25, 26, etc.).

caleb_538.name: Caleb
caleb_538.description: One of the three sons of Hezron of the tribe of Judah. He is also called Chelubai (1 Chr. 2:9). His descendants are enumerated (18-20, 42-49).

ozem_2260.name: Ozem
ozem_2260.description: One of David’s brothers; the sixth son of Jesse (1 Chr. 2:15).

jesher_889.name: Jesher
jesher_889.description: Uprightness, the first of the three sons of Caleb by Azubah (1 Chr. 2:18).

shobab_2716.name: Shobab
shobab_2716.description: One of the sons of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:18), the son of Hezron.

ardon_295.name: Ardon
ardon_295.description: Descendant, the last of the three sons of Caleb by his first wife Azubah (1 Chr. 2:18).

ephratah_1207.name: Ephratah
ephratah_1207.description: The second wife of Caleb, the son of Hezron, mother of Hur, and grandmother of Caleb, who was one of those that were sent to spy the land (1 Chr. 2:19, 50).

ram_2392.name: Ram
ram_2392.description: One of the sons of Jerahmeel (1 Chr. 2:25, 27).

oren_2256.name: Oren
oren_2256.description: Ash or pine, the son of Jerahmeel (1 Chr. 2:25).

ahijah_137.name: Ahijah
ahijah_137.description: One of the five sons of Jerahmeel, who was great-grandson of Judah (1 Chr. 2:25).

nadab_2130.name: Nadab
nadab_2130.description: One of the sons of Shammai in the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 2:28, 30).

abishur_53.name: Abishur
abishur_53.description: Father of the wall; i.e., “mason”, one of the two sons of Shammai of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 2:28, 29).

peleth_2312.name: Peleth
peleth_2312.description: One of the sons of Jonathan (1 Chr. 2:33).

zaza_2987.name: Zaza
zaza_2987.description: Plenty, a descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 2:33).

nathan_2155.name: Nathan
nathan_2155.description: A prophet in the reigns of David and Solomon (2 Chr. 9:29). He is first spoken of in connection with the arrangements David made for the building of the temple (2 Sam. 7:2, 3, 17), and next appears as the reprover of David on account of his sin with Bathsheba (12:1-14). He was charged with the education of Solomon…

jehu_818.name: Jehu
jehu_818.description: The son of Obed, and father of Azariah (1 Chr. 2:38).

eleasah_1060.name: Eleasah
eleasah_1060.description: One of the descendants of Judah, of the family of Hezron (1 Chr. 2:39, “Eleasah”).

shallum_2517.name: Shallum
shallum_2517.description: One of the posterity of Judah (1 Chr. 2:40, 41).

mesha_2010.name: Mesha
mesha_2010.description: Heb. meysh’a, “deliverance,” the eldest son of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:42), and brother of Jerahmeel.

rekem_2419.name: Rekem
rekem_2419.description: One of the sons of Hebron (1 Chr. 2:43, 44).

raham_2389.name: Raham
raham_2389.description: Merciful, one of the descendants of Caleb, the son of Hezron (1 Chr. 2:44).

haran_1408.name: Haran (son of Caleb)
haran_1408.description: The son of Caleb of Judah (1 Chr. 2:46) by his concubine Ephah.

moza_2113.name: Moza
moza_2113.description: One of the sons of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:46).

jahdai_701.name: Jahdai
jahdai_701.description: Grasper, a descendant of Caleb, of the family of Hezron (1 Chr. 2:47).

ephah_1199.name: Ephah
ephah_1199.description:
1 Chr. 2:47, a descendant of Judah.

 Ephah, a word of Egyptian origin, meaning measure; a grain measure containing “three seahs or ten omers,” and equivalent to the bath for liquids (Ex. 16:36; 1 Sam. 17:17; Zech. 5:6). The double ephah in Prov. 20:10 (marg., “an ephah and an ephah”), Deut. 25:14, means two ephahs,…

shobal_2720.name: Shobal
shobal_2720.description: One of the sons of Caleb, and a descendant of Hur (1 Chr. 2:50, 52; 4:1, 2).

nogah_2213.name: Nogah
nogah_2213.description: Splendour, one of David’s sons, born at Jerusalem (1 Chr. 3:7).

johanan_1667.name: Johanan
johanan_1667.description: The oldest of King Josiah’s sons (1 Chr. 3:15).

shealtiel_2456.name: Shealtiel
shealtiel_2456.description: Asked for of God, father of Zerubbabel (Ezra 3:2, 8; Neh. 12:1).

nedabiah_2170.name: Nedabiah
nedabiah_2170.description: Moved of Jehovah, one of the sons of Jeconiah (1 Chr. 3:18).

zerubbabel_3054.name: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel_3054.description: The seed of Babylon, the son of Salathiel or Shealtiel (Hag. 1:1; Zorobabel, Matt. 1:12); called also the son of Pedaiah (1 Chr. 3:17-19), i.e., according to a frequent usage of the word “son;” the grandson or the nephew of Salathiel. He is also known by the Persian name of Sheshbazzar (Ezra 1:8, 11). In the first…

shimei_2686.name: Shimei
shimei_2686.description: A son of Pedaiah, the brother of Zerubbabel (1 Chr. 3:19).

hashubah_1445.name: Hashubah
hashubah_1445.description: Ibid., a descendant of David (1 Chr. 3:20).

ohel_2240.name: Ohel
ohel_2240.description: A house; tent, the fourth son of Zerubbabel (1 Chr. 3:20).

berechiah_471.name: Berechiah
berechiah_471.description: The fourth of the five sons of Zerubbabel, of the royal family of Judah (1 Chr. 3:20).

hasadiah_1426.name: Hasadiah
hasadiah_1426.description: Favoured by Jehovah, one of the sons of Pedaiah (1 Chr. 3:20), of the royal line of David.

pelatiah_2304.name: Pelatiah
pelatiah_2304.description: A son of Hananiah and grandson of Zerubbabel (1 Chr. 3:21).

jesaiah_883.name: Jesaiah
jesaiah_883.description: One of the three sons of Hananiah (1 Chr. 3:21).

shechaniah_2583.name: Shechaniah
shechaniah_2583.description: A priest whose sons are mentioned in 1 Chr. 3:21, 22.

bariah_402.name: Bariah
bariah_402.description: Fugitive, one of Shemaiah’s five sons. Their father is counted along with them in 1 Chr. 3:22.

helah_1478.name: Helah
helah_1478.description: Rust, (1 Chr. 4:5, 7), one of the wives of Ashur.

naarah_2124.name: Naarah
naarah_2124.description: A girl, the second of Ashur’s two wives, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 4:5, 6).

hepher_1497.name: Hepher
hepher_1497.description: The second son of Asher (1 Chr. 4:6).

temeni_2840.name: Temeni
temeni_2840.description: One of the sons of Ashur, the father of Tekoa (1 Chr. 4:6).

coz_958.name: Coz
coz_958.description: A descendant of Judah. 1 Chr. 4:8, “Coz;” R.V., “Hakkoz.”

harum_1423.name: Harum
harum_1423.description: Elevated, (1 Chr. 4:8), a descendant of Judah.

jabez_675.name: Jabez
jabez_675.description: A descendant of Judah, of whom it is recorded that “God granted him that which he requested” (1 Chr. 4:9, 10).

elah_1047.name: Elah
elah_1047.description: The second of the three sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh (1 Chr. 4:15).

naam_2117.name: Naam
naam_2117.description: Pleasantness, one of the three sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh (1 Chr. 4:15).

mered_2005.name: Mered
mered_2005.description: Rebellion, one of the sons of Ezra, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 4:17).

jalon_715.name: Jalon
jalon_715.description: Lodger, the last of the four sons of Ezra, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 4:17).

miriam_2088.name: Miriam
miriam_2088.description: 1 Chr. 4:17, one of the descendants of Judah.

jered_846.name: Jered
jered_846.description: A son of Ezra probably (1 Chr. 4:18).

amnon_233.name: Amnon
amnon_233.description: One of the sons of Shammai, of the children of Ezra (1 Chr. 4:20; comp. 17).

zoheth_3103.name: Zoheth
zoheth_3103.description: Snatching (?), one of the sons of Ishi (1 Chr. 4:20).

jokim_1684.name: Jokim
jokim_1684.description: Whom Jehovah has set up, one of the descendants of Shelah (1 Chr. 4:22).

amaziah_215.name: Amaziah
amaziah_215.description: The father of Joshah, one of the Simeonite chiefs in the time of Hezekiah (1 Chr. 4:34).

jaakobah_660.name: Jaakobah
jaakobah_660.description: Heel-catcher, a form of the name Jacob, one of the descendants of Simeon (1 Chr. 4:36).

adiel_83.name: Adiel
adiel_83.description: A family head of the tribe of Simeon (1 Chr. 4:36).

jedaiah_751.name: Jedaiah
jedaiah_751.description: Invoker of Jehovah. The son of Shimri, a chief Simeonite (1 Chr. 4:37).

gog_1325.name: Gog
gog_1325.description: A Reubenite (1 Chr. 5:4), the father of Shimei.

micah_2050.name: Micah
micah_2050.description: A descendant of Joel the Reubenite (1 Chr. 5:5).

zechariah_3003.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3003.description: One of the chiefs of the tribe of Reuben (1 Chr. 5:7).

jaanai_663.name: Jaanai
jaanai_663.description: Mourner, one of the chief Gadites (1 Chr. 5:12).

michael_2059.name: Michael
michael_2059.description: A chief Gadite in Bashan (1 Chr. 5:13).

meshullam_2022.name: Meshullam
meshullam_2022.description: One of the chief Gadites in Bashan in the time of Jotham (1 Chr. 5:13).

jachan_678.name: Jachan
jachan_678.description: Mourner, one of the chief Gadite “brothers” in Bashan (1 Chr. 5:13).

heber_1472.name: Heber
heber_1472.description: One of the seven heads of the families of the Gadites (1 Chr. 5:13).

buz_530.name: Buz
buz_530.description: One of the chiefs of the tribe of Gad (1 Chr. 5:14).

abdiel_9.name: Abdiel
abdiel_9.description: Servant of God, (1 Chr. 5:15), a Gadite chief.

epher_1203.name: Epher
epher_1203.description: The head of one of the families of trans-Jordanic Manasseh who were carried captive by Tiglath-pileser (1 Chr. 5:24).

eliel_1104.name: Eliel
eliel_1104.description: A chief of Manasseh, on the east of Jordan (1 Chr. 5:24).

jeremiah_849.name: Jeremiah
jeremiah_849.description: One of the chiefs of the tribe of Manasseh on the east of Jordan (1 Chr. 5:24).

abishua_51.name: Abishua
abishua_51.description: The son of Phinehas the high priest (1 Chr. 6:4, 5, 50; Ezra 7:5).

uzzi_2917.name: Uzzi
uzzi_2917.description: The son of Bukki, and a descendant of Aaron (1 Chr. 6:5, 51; Ezra 7:4).

meraioth_2003.name: Meraioth
meraioth_2003.description: Father of Amariah, a high priest of the line of Eleazar (1 Chr. 6:6, 7, 52).

amariah_198.name: Amariah
amariah_198.description: One of the descendants of Aaron by Eleazar (1 Chr. 6:7, 52). He was probably the last of the high priests of Eleazar’s line prior to the transfer of that office to Eli, of the line of Ithamar.

josedech_815.name: Josedech
josedech_815.description: Jehovah-justified, the son of the high priest Seraiah at the time of the Babylonian exile (1 Chr. 6:14, 15). He was carried into captivity by Nebuchadnezzar, and probably died in Babylon. He was the father of Jeshua, or Joshua, who returned with Zerubbabel.

ethan_1622.name: Ethan
ethan_1622.description: A Levite of the family of Gershom (1 Chr. 6:21), probably the same as Ethan (42).

uriel_2900.name: Uriel
uriel_2900.description: A Kohathite ancestor of the prophet Samuel (1 Chr. 6:36).

amasai_209.name: Amasai
amasai_209.description: A Levite, son of Elkanah, of the ancestry of Samuel (1 Chr. 6:25, 35).

mahath_150.name: Mahath
mahath_150.description: A Kohathite Levite, father of Elkanah (1 Chr. 6:35).

shimea_2680.name: Shimea
shimea_2680.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 6:30).

heman_1490.name: Heman
heman_1490.description: Grandson of Samuel (1 Chr. 6:33; 15:17), to whom the 88th Psalm probably was inscribed. He was one of the “seers” named in 2 Chr. 29:14, 30, and took a leading part in the administration of the sacred services.

asaph_330.name: Asaph (Levite)
asaph_330.description: A Levite; one of the leaders of David’s choir (1 Chr. 6:39). Psalms 50 and 73-83 inclusive are attributed to him. He is mentioned along with David as skilled in music, and a “seer” (2 Chr. 29:30). The “sons of Asaph,” mentioned in 1 Chr. 25:1, 2 Chr. 20:14, and Ezra 2:41, were his descendants, or more probably a class…

berechiah_469.name: Berechiah
berechiah_469.description: Son of Shimea, and father of Asaph the musician (1 Chr. 6:39; 15:17).

shimea_2681.name: Shimea
shimea_2681.description: Another Levite of the family of Gershon (1 Chr. 6:39).

shimei_691.name: Shimei
shimei_691.description: A Levite of the family of Gershon (1 Chr. 6:42).

jeduthun_1224.name: Jeduthun (Ethan)
jeduthun_1224.description: A Levite of the family of Merari, one of the leaders of the temple music (1 Chr. 6:44; 15:17, 19). He was probably the same as Jeduthun. He is supposed by some to be the same also as (1).

malluch_1918.name: Malluch
malluch_1918.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 6:44).

amaziah_216.name: Amaziah
amaziah_216.description: A Levite, son of Hilkiah, of the descendants of Ethan the Merarite (1 Chr. 6:45).

shemuel_2654.name: Shemuel
shemuel_2654.description: A prince of the tribe of Issachar (1 Chr. 7:2).

michael_2062.name: Michael
michael_2062.description: 1 Chr. 7:3, a chief of the tribe of Issachar.

obadiah_2217.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2217.description: A chief of the tribe of Issachar (1 Chr. 7:3).

jediael_757.name: Jediael
jediael_757.description: One of the sons of Benjamin, whose descendants numbered 17,200 warriors (1 Chr. 7:6, 10, 11).

uzzi_2919.name: Uzzi
uzzi_2919.description: A son of Bela, and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:7).

uzziel_2931.name: Uzziel
uzziel_2931.description: A son of Bela, and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:7).

jerimoth_864.name: Jerimoth
jerimoth_864.description: One of the sons of Bela (1 Chr. 7:7).

zemira_3037.name: Zemira
zemira_3037.description: Vine-dresser, a Benjamite; one of the sons of Becher (1 Chr. 7:8).

eliezer_1115.name: Eliezer
eliezer_1115.description: The son of Becher, and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:8).

abiah_17.name: Abiah
abiah_17.description: One of the sons of Becher, the son of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:8). “Abiah,” A.V.

alameth_184.name: Alameth
alameth_184.description: One of the nine sons of Becher, the son of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:8).

jeush_1601.name: Jeush
jeush_1601.description: A son of Bilhan, grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:10).

ehud_1040.name: Ehud
ehud_1040.description: A descendant of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:10), his great-grandson.

sheresh_2669.name: Sheresh
sheresh_2669.description: Root, a descendant of Manasseh (1 Chr. 7:16).

hammoleketh_1364.name: Hammoleketh
hammoleketh_1364.description: The queen, the daughter of Machir and sister of Gilead (1 Chr. 7:17, 18). Abiezer was one of her three children.

bered_476.name: Bered
bered_476.description: A son of Shuthelah, and grandson of Ephraim (1 Chr. 7:20).

beriah_479.name: Beriah
beriah_479.description: A son of Ephraim (1 Chr. 7:20-23), born after the slaughter of his brothers, and so called by his father “because it went evil with his house” at that time.

shamer_2725.name: Shamer
shamer_2725.description: A man of Asher (1 Chr. 7:32); called also Shamer (34).

hotham_1562.name: Hotham
hotham_1562.description: A stroke, great-grandson of Asher (1 Chr. 7:35).

shua_2726.name: Shua
shua_2726.description: A daughter of Heber the Asherite (1 Chr. 7:32).

pasach_2279.name: Pasach
pasach_2279.description: Clearing, one of the sons of Japhlet, of the tribe of Asher (1 Chr. 7:33).

zophah_3104.name: Zophah
zophah_3104.description: Spreading out, a son of Helem (1 Chr. 7:35), a chief of Asher.

harnepher_1420.name: Harnepher
harnepher_1420.description: A chief of the tribe of Asher (1 Chr. 7:36).

jephunneh_841.name: Jephunneh
jephunneh_841.description: One of the descendants of Asher (1 Chr. 7:38).

haniel_1399.name: Haniel
haniel_1399.description: A chief of the tribe of Asher (1 Chr. 7:39).

addar_80.name: Addar
addar_80.description: Ample, splendid, son of Bela (1 Chr. 8:3); called also “Ard” (Gen. 46:21)

abihud_34.name: Abihud
abihud_34.description: One of the sons of Bela, the son of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:3); called also Ahihud (ver. 7).

ahoah_168.name: Ahoah
ahoah_168.description: Brotherly, one of the sons of Bela, the son of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:4). He is also called Ahiah (ver. 7) and Iri (1 Chr. 7:7). His descendants were called Ahohites (2 Sam. 23:9, 28).

ahiah_128.name: Ahiah
ahiah_128.description: One of the sons of Bela (1 Chr. 8:7, R.V.). In A.V. called “Ahiah.”

ahihud_134.name: Ahihud
ahihud_134.description: A son of Bela, the son of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:7).

malcham_1900.name: Malcham
malcham_1900.description: (2 Sam. 12:30, Heb., R.V., “their king;” Jer. 49:1, 3, R.V.; Zeph. 1:5), the national idol of the Ammonites. When Rabbah was taken by David, the crown of this idol was among the spoils. The weight is said to have been “a talent of gold” (above 100 lbs.). The expression probably denotes its value rather than its…

abitub_55.name: Abitub
abitub_55.description: Father of goodness, a Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:11).

eber_1031.name: Eber (a Benjamite)
eber_1031.description: The oldest of the three sons of Elpaal the Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:12).

misham_2093.name: Misham
misham_2093.description: Their cleansing or their beholding, a Benjamite, one of the sons of Elpaal (1 Chr. 8:12).

beriah_480.name: Beriah
beriah_480.description: A Benjamite who with his brother Shema founded Ajalon and expelled the Gittites (1 Chr. 8:13).

ahio_155.name: Ahio
ahio_155.description: One of the sons of Beriah (1 Chr. 8:14).

abdon_11.name: Abdon
abdon_11.description:
One of the “sons” of Shashak (1 Chr. 8:23).

 This is the name also of a Levitical town of the Gershonites, in the tribe of Asher (Josh. 21:30; 1 Chr. 6:74). The ruins of Abdeh, some 8 miles north-east of Accho, probably mark its site.

zichri_3067.name: Zichri
zichri_3067.description: Another of the same tribe (1 Chr. 8:23).

hananiah_1385.name: Hananiah
hananiah_1385.description: A chief of the tribe of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:24).

iphedeiah_606.name: Iphedeiah
iphedeiah_606.description: Set free by Jehovah, a chief of the tribe of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:25).

abdon_12.name: Abdon
abdon_12.description: The first-born of Gibeon of the tribe of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:30; 9:36).

baal_575.name: Baal
baal_575.description: A Benjamite, son of Jehiel, the progenitor of the Gibeonites (1 Chr. 8:30; 9:36).

ahio_156.name: Ahio
ahio_156.description: One of the sons of Jehiel the Gibeonite (1 Chr. 8:31; 9:37).

zacher_2972.name: Zacher
zacher_2972.description: Memorial, a son of Jehiel (1 Chr. 8:31; 9:35); called Zechariah (9:37).

shimeah_2682.name: Shimeah
shimeah_2682.description: A Benjamite, a descendant of Gibeon (1 Chr. 8:32); called also Shimeam (9:38).

melech_1993.name: Melech
melech_1993.description: King, the second of Micah’s four sons (1 Chr. 8:35), and thus grandson of Mephibosheth.

alemeth_185.name: Alemeth
alemeth_185.description: One of the sons of Jehoadah, or Jarah, son of Ahaz (1 Chr. 8:36).

moza_2114.name: Moza
moza_2114.description: The son of Zimri, of the posterity of Saul (1 Chr. 8:36, 37; 9:42, 43).

eleasah_1061.name: Eleasah
eleasah_1061.description: A descendant of king Saul (1 Chr. 8:37; 9:43).

azel_551.name: Azel
azel_551.description: Noble, a descendant of king Saul (1 Chr. 8:37; 9:43, 44).

eliphelet_1149.name: Eliphelet
eliphelet_1149.description: A descendant of king Saul through Jonathan (1 Chr. 8:39).

ammihud_227.name: Ammihud
ammihud_227.description: The son of Omri, and the father of Uthai (1 Chr. 9:4).

jeuel_912.name: Jeuel
jeuel_912.description: Snatched away by God, a descendant of Zerah (1 Chr. 9:6).

hasenuah_1427.name: Hasenuah
hasenuah_1427.description: Bristling or hated, a Benjamite (1 Chr. 9:7).

uzzi_2920.name: Uzzi
uzzi_2920.description: A Benjamite, a chief in the tribe (1 Chr. 9:8).

michri_2074.name: Michri
michri_2074.description: Prize of Jehovah, a Benjamite, the father of Uzzi (1 Chr. 9:8).

jedaiah_752.name: Jedaiah
jedaiah_752.description: A priest in Jerusalem after the Exile (1 Chr. 9:10).

joiarib_797.name: Joiarib
joiarib_797.description: The founder of one of the courses of the priests (Neh. 11:10).

jachin_680.name: Jachin
jachin_680.description: One of the priests who returned from the Exile (1 Chr. 9:10).

jeroham_877.name: Jeroham
jeroham_877.description: 1 Chr. 9:12; a priest, perhaps the same as in Neh. 11:12.

maasiai_1870.name: Maasiai
maasiai_1870.description: Work of Jehovah, one of the priests resident at Jerusalem at the Captivity (1 Chr. 9:12).

jahzerah_707.name: Jahzerah
jahzerah_707.description: Returner, the son of Meshullam, and father of Adiel (1 Chr. 9:12).

meshillemith_2017.name: Meshillemith
meshillemith_2017.description: A priest, the son of Immer (Neh. 11:13).

hasshub_1450.name: Hasshub
hasshub_1450.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (Neh. 11:15; 1 Chr. 9:14).

micha_2051.name: Micha
micha_2051.description: The son of Zabdi, a Levite of the family of Asaph (Neh. 11:17, 22).

zichri_3069.name: Zichri
zichri_3069.description: A Levite, one of the sons of Asaph (Neh. 11:17); probably the same as Zichri (1 Chr. 9:15), and Zaccur (Neh. 12:35).

obadiah_2219.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2219.description: A Levite, after the Captivity (1 Chr. 9:16).

shallum_2520.name: Shallum
shallum_2520.description: A keeper of the gate in the reign of David (1 Chr. 9:17).

akkub_181.name: Akkub
akkub_181.description: A Levite who kept the gate of the temple after the return from Babylon (1 Chr. 9:17; Ezra 2:42; Neh. 7:45).

ahiman_147.name: Ahiman
ahiman_147.description: One of the guardians of the temple after the Exile (1 Chr. 9:17).

kore_1797.name: Kore
kore_1797.description: A Levite and temple-warder of the Korahites, the son of Asaph. He was father of Shallum and Meshelemiah, temple-porters (1 Chr. 9:19; 26:1).

zechariah_3004.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3004.description: A Levite who assisted at the bringing up of the ark from the house of Obededom (1 Chr. 15:20-24).

meshelemiah_2013.name: Meshelemiah
meshelemiah_2013.description: Friendship of Jehovah, a Levite of the family of the Korhites, called also Shelemiah (1 Chr. 9:21; 26:1, 2, 9, 14). He was a temple gate-keeper in the time of David.

mattithiah_1973.name: Mattithiah
mattithiah_1973.description: The eldest son of Shallum, of the family of Korah (1 Chr. 9:31).

jashobeam_738.name: Jashobeam
jashobeam_738.description: Dweller among the people; or to whom the people turn, the Hachmonite (1 Chr. 11:11), one of David’s chief heroes who joined him at Ziklag (12:6). He was the first of the three who broke through the host of the Philistines to fetch water to David from the well of Bethlehem (2 Sam. 23:13-17). He is also called Adino the…

abiel_18.name: Abiel (Arbathite)
abiel_18.description: An Arbathite, one of David’s warriors (1 Chr. 11:32); called also Abi-albon (2 Sam. 23:31).

ahijah_138.name: Ahijah
ahijah_138.description: A Pelonite, one of David’s heroes (1 Chr. 11:36); called also Eliam (2 Sam. 23:34).

naarai_2125.name: Naarai
naarai_2125.description: Youthful, a military chief in David’s army (1 Chr. 11:37), called also Paarai (2 Sam. 23:35).

joel_1653.name: Joel
joel_1653.description: One of David’s famous warriors (1 Chr. 11:38).

mibhar_2045.name: Mibhar
mibhar_2045.description: Choice, a Hagarene, one of David’s warriors (1 Chr. 11:38); called also Bani the Gadite (2 Sam. 23:36).

zabad_2947.name: Zabad
zabad_2947.description: One of David’s valiant men (1 Chr. 11:41), the descendant of Ahlai, of the “children of Sheshan” (2:31).

adina_88.name: Adina
adina_88.description: Slender, one of David’s warriors (1 Chr. 11:42), a Reubenite.

maachah_1845.name: Maachah
maachah_1845.description: The father of Hanan, who was one of David’s body-guard (1 Chr. 11:43).

jediael_758.name: Jediael
jediael_758.description: A Shimrite, one of David’s bodyguard (1 Chr. 11:45). Probably same as in 12:20.

shimri_2704.name: Shimri
shimri_2704.description: The father of one of the “valiant men” of David’s armies (1 Chr. 11:45).

ahiezer_132.name: Ahiezer
ahiezer_132.description: The chief of the Benjamite slingers that repaired to David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:3).

joash_1636.name: Joash
joash_1636.description: One of the Benjamite archers who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:3).

shemaah_2618.name: Shemaah
shemaah_2618.description: Rumour, a Benjamite whose sons “came to David to Ziklag” (1 Chr. 12:3).

jeziel_1608.name: Jeziel
jeziel_1608.description: Assembled by God, a son of Azmaveth. He was one of the Benjamite archers who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:3).

pelet_2310.name: Pelet
pelet_2310.description: A Benjamite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:3).

berachah_468.name: Berachah
berachah_468.description: One of the Benjamite warriors, Saul’s brethren, who joined David when at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:3).

jehu_820.name: Jehu
jehu_820.description: One of the Benjamite slingers that joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:3).

ismaiah_643.name: Ismaiah
ismaiah_643.description: A Gibeonite who joined David at Ziklag, “a hero among the thirty and over the thirty” (1 Chr. 12:4).

jeremiah_850.name: Jeremiah
jeremiah_850.description: A Benjamite slinger who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:4).

josabad_1708.name: Josabad
josabad_1708.description: One of the Benjamite archers who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:4).

jerimoth_866.name: Jerimoth
jerimoth_866.description: A Benjamite slinger who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5).

bealiah_419.name: Bealiah
bealiah_419.description: Whose Lord is Jehovah, a Benjamite, one of David’s thirty heroes of the sling and bow (1 Chr. 12:5).

shemariah_2645.name: Shemariah
shemariah_2645.description: One who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5).

shephatiah_2658.name: Shephatiah
shephatiah_2658.description: A Benjamite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5).

joezer_1662.name: Joezer
joezer_1662.description: Jehovah is his help, one of the Korhites who became part of David’s body-guard (1 Chr. 12:6).

joelah_1661.name: Joelah
joelah_1661.description: A Benjamite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:7).

obadiah_2220.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2220.description: A Gadite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:9).

eliab_1076.name: Eliab
eliab_1076.description: One of the Gadite heroes who joined David in his stronghold in the wilderness (1 Chr. 12:9).

mishmannah_2096.name: Mishmannah
mishmannah_2096.description: Fatness, one of the Gadite heroes who gathered to David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:10).

jeremiah_851.name: Jeremiah
jeremiah_851.description: A Gadite who joined David in the wilderness (1 Chr. 12:10).

eliel_1109.name: Eliel
eliel_1109.description: A Gadite who joined David in the hold at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:11).

johanan_1671.name: Johanan
johanan_1671.description: One of the Gadite heroes who joined David in the desert of Judah (1 Chr. 12:12).

amasai_210.name: Amasai
amasai_210.description: The leader of a body of men who joined David in the “stronghold,” probably of Adullam (1 Chr. 12:18).

adnah_94.name: Adnah
adnah_94.description: A chief of the tribe of Manasseh who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:20).

michael_2064.name: Michael
michael_2064.description: A Manassite, “a captain of thousands” who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:20).

elihu_1127.name: Elihu
elihu_1127.description: One of the captains of thousands of Manasseh who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:20).

zilthai_3083.name: Zilthai
zilthai_3083.description: One of the captains of the tribe of Manasseh who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:20).

uriel_2901.name: Uriel
uriel_2901.description: The chief of the Kohathites at the time when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 15:5, 11).

joel_1654.name: Joel
joel_1654.description: A Levite of the family of Gershom (1 Chr. 15:7, 11).

shemaiah_2625.name: Shemaiah
shemaiah_2625.description: A Levite in the time of David, who with 200 of his brethren took part in the bringing up of the ark from Obed-edom to Hebron (1 Chr. 15:8).

amminadab_229.name: Amminadab
amminadab_229.description: Chief of the 112 descendants of Uzziel the Levite (1 Chr. 15:10, 11).

jaaziel_672.name: Jaaziel
jaaziel_672.description: Comforted by God, a Levitical musician (1 Chr. 15:18).

shemiramoth_2651.name: Shemiramoth
shemiramoth_2651.description: A Levite in David’s time (1 Chr. 15:18, 20).

jehiel_770.name: Jehiel
jehiel_770.description: One of the Levites “of the second degree,” appointed to conduct the music on the occasion of the ark’s being removed to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 15:18, 20).

unni_2891.name: Unni
unni_2891.description: A Levite whom David appointed to take part in bringing the ark up to Jerusalem from the house of Obed-edom by playing the psaltery on that occasion (1 Chr. 15:18, 20).

maaseiah_1849.name: Maaseiah
maaseiah_1849.description: One of the Levites whom David appointed as porter for the ark (1 Chr. 15:18, 20).

mattithiah_1974.name: Mattithiah
mattithiah_1974.description: One of the sons of Jeduthun (1 Chr. 25:3, 21).

elipheleh_1146.name: Elipheleh
elipheleh_1146.description: God will distinguish him, one of the porters appointed to play “on the Sheminith” on the occasion of the bringing up of the ark to the city of David (1 Chr. 15:18, 21).

jeiel_827.name: Jeiel
jeiel_827.description: One of the Levites who took part in praising God on the removal of the ark to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 16:5).

azaziah_547.name: Azaziah
azaziah_547.description: One of the Levitical harpers in the temple (1 Chr. 15:21).

chenaniah_935.name: Chenaniah
chenaniah_935.description: Whom Jehovah hath made. “Chief of the Levites,” probably a Kohathite (1 Chr. 15:22), and therefore not the same as mentioned in 26:29.

shebaniah_2572.name: Shebaniah
shebaniah_2572.description: A Levite appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark of God (1 Chr. 15:24).

jehoshaphat_810.name: Jehoshaphat
jehoshaphat_810.description: One of the priests who accompanied the removal of the ark to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 15:24).

nethaneel_2190.name: Nethaneel
nethaneel_2190.description: A priest who blew the trumpet before the ark when it was brought up to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 15:24).

amasai_211.name: Amasai
amasai_211.description: One of the priests appointed to precede the ark with blowing of trumpets on its removal from the house of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 15:24).

eliezer_1116.name: Eliezer
eliezer_1116.description: One of the priests who blew the trumpet before the ark when it was brought to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 15:24).

jahaziel_697.name: Jahaziel
jahaziel_697.description: A priest who accompanied the removal of the ark to Jerusalem (1 Chr. 16:6).

hosah_1554.name: Hosah
hosah_1554.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 16:38).

satan_2476.name: Satan
satan_2476.description:
Adversary; accuser. When used as a proper name, the Hebrew word so rendered has the article “the adversary” (Job 1:6-12; 2:1-7). In the New Testament it is used as interchangeable with Diabolos, or the devil, and is so used more than thirty times.

 He is also called “the dragon,” “the old serpent” (Rev. 12:9; 20:2);…

jahath_692.name: Jahath
jahath_692.description: A son of Shimei, and grandson of Gershom (1 Chr. 23:10).

jeush_1602.name: Jeush
jeush_1602.description: A Levite, one of the sons of Shimei (1 Chr. 23:10, 11).

shubael_2579.name: Shubael
shubael_2579.description: One of the descendants of Gershom, who had charge of the temple treasures in the time of David (1 Chr. 23:16; 26:24).

rehabiah_2409.name: Rehabiah
rehabiah_2409.description: Enlargement of the Lord, the son of Eliezer, and grandson of Moses (1 Chr. 23:17; 24:21).

amariah_200.name: Amariah
amariah_200.description: A Levite, son of Hebron, of the lineage of Moses (1 Chr. 23:19; 24:23).

jahaziel_698.name: Jahaziel
jahaziel_698.description: The third son of Hebron (1 Chr. 23:19).

michah_2052.name: Michah
michah_2052.description: The first in rank of the priests of the family of Kohathites (1 Chr. 23:20).

eleazar_1065.name: Eleazar
eleazar_1065.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 23:21, 22).

kish_1785.name: Kish
kish_1785.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 23:21; 24:29).

eder_1035.name: Eder
eder_1035.description: The second of the three sons of Mushi, of the family of Merari, appointed to the Levitical office (1 Chr. 23:23; 24:30).

jehoiarib_798.name: Jehoiarib
jehoiarib_798.description: Jehovah defends, a priest at Jerusalem, head of one of the sacerdotal courses (1 Chr. 9:10; 24:7). His “course” went up from Babylon after the Exile (Ezra 2:36-39; Neh. 7:39-42).

jedaiah_753.name: Jedaiah
jedaiah_753.description: Knowing Jehovah. The chief of one of the courses of the priests (1 Chr. 24:7).

harim_1416.name: Harim
harim_1416.description: The head of the second course of priests (1 Chr. 24:8).

seorim_2491.name: Seorim
seorim_2491.description: Barley, the chief of the forth priestly course (1 Chr. 24:8).

malchijah_1910.name: Malchijah
malchijah_1910.description: The head of the fifth division of the priests in the time of David (1 Chr. 24:9).

hakkoz_1355.name: Hakkoz
hakkoz_1355.description: The thorn, the head of one of the courses of the priests (1 Chr. 24:10).

abijah_36.name: Abijah
abijah_36.description: A descendant of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, a chief of one of the twenty-four orders into which the priesthood was divided by David (1 Chr. 24:10). The order of Abijah was one of those which did not return from the Captivity (Ezra 2:36-39; Neh. 7:39-42; 12:1).

jeshua_899.name: Jeshua
jeshua_899.description: Head of the ninth priestly order (Ezra 2:36); called also Jeshuah (1 Chr. 24:11).

shecaniah_2581.name: Shecaniah
shecaniah_2581.description: A priest to whom the tenth lot came forth when David divided the priests (1 Chr. 24:11).

eliashib_1094.name: Eliashib
eliashib_1094.description: A priest, head of one of the courses of the priests of the time of David (1 Chr. 24:12).

jakim_714.name: Jakim
jakim_714.description: Chief of the twelfth priestly order (1 Chr. 24:12).

jeshebeab_888.name: Jeshebeab
jeshebeab_888.description: Seat of his father, the head of the fourteenth division of priests (1 Chr. 24:13).

bilgah_500.name: Bilgah
bilgah_500.description: The head of the fifteenth sacerdotal course for the temple service (1 Chr. 24:14).

immer_599.name: Immer
immer_599.description: The head of the sixteenth priestly order (1 Chr. 24:14).

hezir_1516.name: Hezir
hezir_1516.description: The head of the seventeenth course of the priests (1 Chr. 24:15).

pethahiah_2319.name: Pethahiah
pethahiah_2319.description: The chief of one of the priestly courses (the nineteenth) in the time of David (1 Chr. 24:16).

jachin_681.name: Jachin
jachin_681.description: The head of one of the courses (the twenty-first) of priests (1 Chr. 24:17).

gamul_1278.name: Gamul
gamul_1278.description: Weaned the leader of one of the priestly courses (1 Chr. 24:17).

delaiah_1001.name: Delaiah
delaiah_1001.description: The head of the twenty-third division of the priestly order (1 Chr. 24:18).

maaziah_1873.name: Maaziah
maaziah_1873.description: The head of the twenty-fourth priestly course (1 Chr. 24:18) in David’s reign.

jehdeiah_766.name: Jehdeiah
jehdeiah_766.description: One of the Levitical attendants at the temple, a descendant of Shubael (1 Chr. 24:20).

jeshaiah_647.name: Jeshaiah
jeshaiah_647.description: A Kohathite Levite, the father of Joram, of the family of Eliezer (1 Chr. 26:25); called also Isshiah (24:21).

jahath_693.name: Jahath
jahath_693.description: One of the sons of Shelomoth, of the family of Kohath (1 Chr. 24:22).

shamir_2536.name: Shamir
shamir_2536.description: One of the sons of Michah (1 Chr. 24:24).

jaaziah_671.name: Jaaziah
jaaziah_671.description: Comforted by Jehovah, a descendant of Merari the Levite (1 Chr. 24:26, 27).

jerahmeel_844.name: Jerahmeel
jerahmeel_844.description: The son of Kish, a Levite (1 Chr. 24:29).

zaccur_2965.name: Zaccur
zaccur_2965.description: A son of Asaph, and chief of one of the courses of singers as arranged by David (1 Chr. 25:2, 10).

joseph_1712.name: Joseph (son of Asaph)
joseph_1712.description: One of the sons of Asaph, head of the first division of sacred musicians (1 Chr. 25:2, 9).

jesharelah_334.name: Jesharelah
jesharelah_334.description: Upright towards God, the head of the seventh division of Levitical musicians (1 Chr. 25:14).

jeshaiah_885.name: Jeshaiah
jeshaiah_885.description: One of the sons of Jeduthum (1 Chr. 25:3, 15).

mattaniah_1952.name: Mattaniah
mattaniah_1952.description: A Levite, son of Heman, the chief of the ninth class of temple singers (1 Chr. 25:4, 16).

uzziel_2932.name: Uzziel
uzziel_2932.description: One of the sons of Heman (1 Chr. 25:4); called also Azareel (18).

shubael_2580.name: Shubael
shubael_2580.description: One of the sons of Heman; one of those whose duty it was to “lift up the horn” in the temple service (1 Chr. 25:4, 5); called also Shubael (ver. 20).

jerimoth_867.name: Jerimoth
jerimoth_867.description: A Levitical musician under Heman his father (1 Chr. 25:4).

hananiah_1386.name: Hananiah
hananiah_1386.description: One of the sons of Heman (1 Chr. 25:4, 23).

hanani_1380.name: Hanani
hanani_1380.description: One of the sons of Heman (1 Chr. 25:4, 25).

eliathah_1102.name: Eliathah
eliathah_1102.description: To whom God will come, one of the foureen sons of the Levite Heman, and musician of the temple in the time of David (1 Chr. 25:4).

romamti-ezer_2446.name: Romamti-ezer
romamti-ezer_2446.description: Elevation of help, one of the sons of Heman, “the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn.” He was head of the “four-and-twentieth” course of singers (1 Chr. 25:4, 31).

mallothi_1917.name: Mallothi
mallothi_1917.description: My fulness, a Kohathite Levite, one of the sons of Heman the Levite (1 Chr. 25:4), and chief of the nineteenth division of the temple musicians (26).

mahazioth_1893.name: Mahazioth
mahazioth_1893.description: Visions, a Kohathite Levite, chief of the twenty-third course of musicians (1 Chr. 25:4, 30).

jediael_760.name: Jediael
jediael_760.description: A Korhite of the family of Ebiasaph, and one of the gate-keepers to the temple (1 Chr. 26:2).

zebadiah_2991.name: Zebadiah
zebadiah_2991.description: A Korhite porter of the Lord’s house (1 Chr. 26:2). Three or four others of this name are also mentioned.

jehohanan_785.name: Jehohanan
jehohanan_785.description: A Korhite, the head of one of the divisions of the temple porters (1 Chr. 26:3).

shemaiah_2627.name: Shemaiah
shemaiah_2627.description: The eldest son of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 26:4-8).

jehozabad_813.name: Jehozabad
jehozabad_813.description: The son of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 26:4), one of the Levite porters.

joah_1623.name: Joah
joah_1623.description: One of the sons of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 26:4), a Korhite porter.

sacar_2453.name: Sacar
sacar_2453.description: A son of Obed-edom the Gittite, and a temple porter (1 Chr. 26:4).

nethaneel_2192.name: Nethaneel
nethaneel_2192.description: A temple porter, of the family of the Korhites (1 Chr. 26:4).

ammiel_222.name: Ammiel
ammiel_222.description: One of the sons of Obed-edom the Levite (1 Chr. 26:5).

peulthai_2324.name: Peulthai
peulthai_2324.description: Wages of the Lord, one of the sons of Obed-edom, a Levite porter (1 Chr. 26:5).

othni_2258.name: Othni
othni_2258.description: A lion of Jehovah, a son of Shemaiah, and one of the temple porters in the time of David (1 Chr. 26:7). He was a “mighty man of valour.”

rephael_2421.name: Rephael
rephael_2421.description: Healed of God, one of Shemaiah’s sons. He and his brethren, on account of their “strength for service,” formed one of the divisions of the temple porters (1 Chr. 26:7, 8).

elihu_1128.name: Elihu
elihu_1128.description: One of the family of Obed-edom, who were appointed porters of the temple under David (1 Chr. 26:7).

simri_2754.name: Simri
simri_2754.description: Watchman, a Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 26:10).

ahijah_139.name: Ahijah
ahijah_139.description: A Levite having charge of the sacred treasury in the temple (1 Chr. 26:20).

zabdiel_2957.name: Zabdiel
zabdiel_2957.description: The father of Jashobeam, who was one of David’s officers (1 Chr. 27:2).

mikloth_2079.name: Mikloth
mikloth_2079.description: An officer under Dodai, in the time of David and Solomon (1 Chr. 27:4).

ammizabad_231.name: Ammizabad
ammizabad_231.description: People of the giver, the son of Benaiah, who was the third and chief captain of the host under David (1 Chr. 27:6).

zebadiah_2992.name: Zebadiah
zebadiah_2992.description: A son of Asahel, Joab’s brother (1 Chr. 27:7).

eliezer_1117.name: Eliezer
eliezer_1117.description: Son of Zichri, and chief of the Reubenites under David (1 Chr. 27:16).

shephatiah_2659.name: Shephatiah
shephatiah_2659.description: A Simeonite prince in David’s time (1 Chr. 27:16).

ishmaiah_636.name: Ishmaiah
ishmaiah_636.description: Son of Obadiah, and viceroy of Zebulun under David and Solomon (1 Chr. 27:19).

obadiah_2221.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2221.description: A prince of Zebulun in the time of David (1 Chr. 27:19).

hoshea_1560.name: Hoshea
hoshea_1560.description: 1 Chr. 27:20. The ruler of Ephraim in David’s time.

azaziah_548.name: Azaziah
azaziah_548.description: The father of Hoshea, who was made ruler over the Ephraimites (1 Chr. 27:20).

pedaiah_2294.name: Pedaiah
pedaiah_2294.description: . The father of Joel, ruler of the half-tribe of Manasseh (1 Chr. 27:20).

iddo_1593.name: Iddo
iddo_1593.description: Lovely. The son of Zechariah (1 Chr. 27:21), the ruler of Manasseh in David’s time.

jaasiel_666.name: Jaasiel
jaasiel_666.description: Made by God, one of David’s body-guard, the son of Abner (1 Chr. 27:21), called Jasiel in 1 Chr. 11:47.

jeroham_879.name: Jeroham
jeroham_879.description: The father of Azareel, the “captain” of the tribe of Dan (1 Chr. 27:22).

azmaveth_558.name: Azmaveth
azmaveth_558.description: An overseer over the royal treasury in the time of David and Solomon (1 Chr. 27:25).

jehonathan_800.name: Jehonathan
jehonathan_800.description: One of the stewards of David’s store-houses (1 Chr. 27:25).

uzziah_2926.name: Uzziah
uzziah_2926.description: The father of Jehonathan, one of David’s overseers (1 Chr. 27:25).

ezri_1247.name: Ezri
ezri_1247.description: Help of Jehovah, the son of Chelub. He superintended, under David, those who “did the work of the field for tillage” (1 Chr. 27:26).

shimei_2690.name: Shimei
shimei_2690.description: A Ramathite who was “over the vineyards” of David (1 Chr. 27:27).

zabdi_2956.name: Zabdi
zabdi_2956.description: Called “the Shiphmite,” one of David’s officers, who had charge of his vineyards (1 Chr. 27:27).

baal-hanan_577.name: Baalhanan
baal-hanan_577.description: An overseer of “the olive trees and sycomore trees in the low plains” (the Shephelah) under David (1 Chr. 27:28).

joash_1637.name: Joash
joash_1637.description: One who had charge of the royal stores of oil under David and Solomon (1 Chr. 27:28).

shaphat_2556.name: Shaphat
shaphat_2556.description: One of David’s chief herdsmen (1 Chr. 27:29).

obil_2234.name: Obil
obil_2234.description: A keeper of camels, an Ishmaelite who was “over the camels” in the time of David (1 Chr. 27:30).

jehdeiah_767.name: Jehdeiah
jehdeiah_767.description: A Meronothite, herdsman of the asses under David and Solomon (1 Chr. 27:30).

jehiel_772.name: Jehiel
jehiel_772.description: A Hachmonite, a tutor in the family of David toward the close of his reign (1 Chr. 27:32).

iddo_1594.name: Iddo
iddo_1594.description: Lovely. A prophet of Judah who wrote the history of Rehoboam and Abijah (2 Chr. 12:15). He has been identified with Oded (2 Chr. 15:1).

mahalath_1888.name: Mahalath
mahalath_1888.description: The daughter of Jerimoth, who was one of David’s sons. She was one of Rehoboam’s wives (2 Chr. 11:18).

abihail_31.name: Abihail
abihail_31.description: The second wife of King Rehoboam (2 Chr. 11:18), a descendant of Eliab, David’s eldest brother.

jeush_1603.name: Jeush
jeush_1603.description: One of the three sons of Rehoboam (2 Chr. 11:19).

uriel_2902.name: Uriel
uriel_2902.description: The father of Michaiah, one of Rehoboam’s wives, and mother of Abijah (2 Chr. 13:2).

zerah_3046.name: Zerah
zerah_3046.description: An “Ethiopian,” probably Osorkon II., the successor of Shishak on the throne of Egypt. With an enormous army, the largest we read of in Scripture, he invaded the kingdom of Judah in the days of Asa (2 Chr. 14:9-15). He reached Zephathah, and there encountered the army of Asa. This is the only instance “in all the…

azariah_380.name: Azariah
azariah_380.description: The son of Oded, a remarkable prophet in the days of Asa (2 Chr. 15:1). He stirred up the king and the people to a great national reformation.

obadiah_2222.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2222.description: One of the princes sent by Jehoshaphat to instruct the people in the law (2 Chr. 17:7).

zechariah_3008.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3008.description: One who assisted in teaching the law to the people in the time of Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:7).

nethaneel_2193.name: Nethaneel
nethaneel_2193.description: One of the “princes” appointed by Jehoshaphat to teach the law through the cities of Judah (2 Chr. 17:7).

michaiah_2070.name: Michaiah
michaiah_2070.description: One of those sent out by Jehoshaphat to instruct the people in the law (2 Chr. 17:7).

shemaiah_2628.name: Shemaiah
shemaiah_2628.description: One of the Levites whom Jehoshaphat appointed to teach the law (2 Chr. 17:8).

nethaniah_2200.name: Nethaniah
nethaniah_2200.description: A Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the law (2 Chr. 17:8).

zebadiah_2993.name: Zebadiah
zebadiah_2993.description: A Levite who took part as one of the teachers in the system of national education instituted by Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:7, 8).

shemiramoth_2652.name: Shemiramoth
shemiramoth_2652.description: A Levite in the reign of Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:8).

jehonathan_801.name: Jehonathan
jehonathan_801.description: A Levite who taught the law to the people of Judah (2 Chr. 17:8).

adonijah_98.name: Adonijah
adonijah_98.description: A Levite sent with the princes to teach the book of the law to the inhabitants of Judah (2 Chr. 17:8).

tobijah_2873.name: Tobijah
tobijah_2873.description: Id., a Levite sent out through Judah by Jehoshaphat to teach the people (2 Chr. 17:8).

tobadonijah_2870.name: Tobadonijah
tobadonijah_2870.description: Good is Jehovah, my Lord, a Levite sent out by Jehoshaphat to instruct the people of Judah in the law (2 Chr. 17:8).

elishama_1159.name: Elishama
elishama_1159.description: A priest sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the people the law (2 Chr. 17:8).

jehoram_805.name: Jehoram
jehoram_805.description: A priest sent by Jehoshaphat to instructruct the people in Judah (2 Chr. 17:8).

adnah_95.name: Adnah
adnah_95.description: A general under Jehoshaphat, chief over 300,000 men (2 Chr. 17:14).

amasiah_213.name: Amasiah
amasiah_213.description: Burden of (i.e., “sustained by”) Jehovah, the “son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the Lord,” a captain over thousands under Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:16; comp. Judg. 5:9).

eliada_1079.name: Eliada
eliada_1079.description: A mighty man of war, a Benjamite (2 Chr. 17:17).

amariah_201.name: Amariah
amariah_201.description: A “chief priest” who took an active part in the reformation under Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 19:11); probably the same as mentioned in 1 Chr. 6:9.

zebadiah_2994.name: Zebadiah
zebadiah_2994.description: The son of Ishmael, “the ruler of the house of Judah in all the king’s matters” (2 Chr. 19:8-11).

jahaziel_699.name: Jahaziel
jahaziel_699.description: The son of Zechariah, a Levite of the family of Asaph (2 Chr. 20:14-17). He encouraged Jehoshaphat against the Moabites and Ammonites.

zechariah_3009.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3009.description: A Levite of the sons of Asaph (2 Chr. 20:14).

eliezer_1118.name: Eliezer
eliezer_1118.description: A prophet in the time of Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 20:37). Others of this name are mentioned Luke 3:29; Ezra 8:16; 10:18, 23, 31.

jehiel_773.name: Jehiel
jehiel_773.description: The second of Jehoshaphat’s six sons (2 Chr. 21:2).

michael_2066.name: Michael
michael_2066.description: One of the sons of king Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 21:2, 4). He was murdered by his brother Jehoram.

jeroham_880.name: Jeroham
jeroham_880.description: 2 Chr. 23:1; one whose son assisted in placing Joash on the throne.

maaseiah_1850.name: Maaseiah
maaseiah_1850.description: One of the “captains of hundreds” associated with Jehoiada in restoring king Jehoash to the throne (2 Chr. 23:1).

elishaphat_1161.name: Elishaphat
elishaphat_1161.description: Whom God has judged, one of the “captains of hundreds” associated with Jehoiada in the league to overthrow the usurpation of Athaliah (2 Chr. 23:1).

zacharias_3011.name: Zacharias
zacharias_3011.description: The son or grandson of Jehoiada, the high priest in the times of Ahaziah and Joash. After the death of Jehoiada he boldly condemned both the king and the people for their rebellion against God (2 Chr. 24:20), which so stirred up their resentment against him that at the king’s commandment they stoned him with stones,…

zechariah_3012.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3012.description:
A prophet, who had “understanding in the seeing of God,” in the time of Uzziah, who was much indebted to him for his wise counsel (2 Chr. 26:5).

 Besides these, there is a large number of persons mentioned in Scripture bearing this name of whom nothing is known.

hananiah_1387.name: Hananiah
hananiah_1387.description: One of Uzziah’s military officers (2 Chr. 26:11).

azariah_385.name: Azariah
azariah_385.description: High priest in the reign of Uzziah, king of Judah (2 Kings 14:21; 2 Chr. 26:17-20). He was contemporary with the prophets Isaiah, Amos, and Joel.

oded_2237.name: Oded
oded_2237.description: A prophet in the time of Ahaz and Pekah (2 Chr. 28:9-15).

berechiah_473.name: Berechiah
berechiah_473.description: One of the seven Ephraimite chieftains, son of Meshillemoth (2 Chr. 28:12).

jehizkiah_781.name: Jehizkiah
jehizkiah_781.description: Jehovah strengthens, one of the chiefs of Ephraim (2 Chr. 28:12).

amasa_208.name: Amasa
amasa_208.description: A son of Hadlai, and chief of Ephraim (2 Chr. 28:12) in the reign of Ahaz.

hadlai_1344.name: Hadlai
hadlai_1344.description: Resting, an Ephraimite; the father of Amasa, mentioned in 2 Chr. 28:12.

mahath_1891.name: Mahath
mahath_1891.description: Another Kohathite Levite, of the time of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:12).

amasai_212.name: Amasai
amasai_212.description: The father of a Levite, one of the two Kohathites who took a prominent part at the instance of Hezekiah in the cleansing of the temple (2 Chr. 29:12).

kish_1786.name: Kish
kish_1786.description: A Levite in the time of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:12).

jehalelel_765.name: Jehalelel
jehalelel_765.description: A Levite of the family of Merari (2 Chr. 29:12).

eden_1033.name: Eden
eden_1033.description: Son of Joah, and one of the Levites who assisted in reforming the public worship of the sanctuary in the time of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:12).

shimri_2705.name: Shimri
shimri_2705.description: Assisted at the purification of the temple in the time of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:13).

jeiel_830.name: Jeiel
jeiel_830.description: 2 Chr. 29:13. A Levite of the sons of Asaph.

mattaniah_1954.name: Mattaniah
mattaniah_1954.description: A Levite who assisted in purifying the temple at the reformation under Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:13).

jehiel_774.name: Jehiel
jehiel_774.description: One of the Levites of the family of Heman who assisted Hezekiah in his work of reformation (2 Chr. 29:14).

shimei_2691.name: Shimei
shimei_2691.description: One of the sons of Heman, who assisted in the purification of the temple (2 Chr. 29:14).

azaziah_549.name: Azaziah
azaziah_549.description: One who had charge of the temple offerings (2 Chr. 31:13).

nahath_2140.name: Nahath
nahath_2140.description: A Levite, one of the overseers of the sacred offerings of the temple (2 Chr. 31:13).

jerimoth_870.name: Jerimoth
jerimoth_870.description: A Levite, one of the overseers of the temple offerings (2 Chr. 31:13) in the reign of Hezekiah.

eliel_1111.name: Eliel
eliel_1111.description: One of the overseers of the offerings in the reign of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 31:13).

kore_1798.name: Kore
kore_1798.description: A Levitical porter at the east gate of the temple (2 Chr. 31:14).

jeshua_892.name: Jeshua
jeshua_892.description: A Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute offerings in the priestly cities (2 Chr. 31:15).

shemaiah_2630.name: Shemaiah
shemaiah_2630.description: A Levite appointed to “distribute the oblations of the Lord” (2 Chr. 31:15).

amariah_202.name: Amariah
amariah_202.description: One of the high priests in the time of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 31:15).

shecaniah_2582.name: Shecaniah
shecaniah_2582.description:
One of the priests who were set “to give to their brethren by courses” of the daily portion (2 Chr. 31:15).

 Shechani’ah, id.

maaseiah_1853.name: Maaseiah
maaseiah_1853.description: One who was sent by king Josiah to repair the temple (2 Chr. 34:8). He was governor (Heb. sar, rendered elsewhere in the Authorized Version “prince,” “chief captain,” chief ruler”) of Jerusalem.

joah_1626.name: Joah
joah_1626.description: Son of Joahaz, and “recorder” (q.v.) or keeper of the state archives under King Josiah (2 Chr. 34:8).

joahaz_1627.name: Joahaz
joahaz_1627.description: (2 Chr. 34:8), a contracted form of Jehoahaz (q.v.).

jahath_694.name: Jahath
jahath_694.description: A Levite of the family of Merari, one of the overseers of the repairs of the temple under Josiah (2 Chr. 34:12).

obadiah_2223.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2223.description: A Levite who superintended the repairs of the temple under Josiah (2 Chr. 34:12).

zechariah_3015.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3015.description: One of the “rulers of the house of God” (2 Chr. 35:8).

jehiel_776.name: Jehiel
jehiel_776.description: A “prince” and “ruler of the house of God” who contributed liberally to the renewal of the temple sacrifices under Josiah (2 Chr. 35:8).

conaniah_953.name: Conaniah
conaniah_953.description: Whom Jehovah hath set, a Levite placed over the tithes brought into the temple (2 Chr. 35:9).

nethaneel_2194.name: Nethaneel
nethaneel_2194.description: A chief Levite in the time of Josiah (2 Chr. 35:9).

hashabiah_1433.name: Hashabiah
hashabiah_1433.description: One of the chief Levites (2 Chr. 35:9).

jeiel_831.name: Jeiel
jeiel_831.description: One of the chief Levites, who made an offering for the restoration of the Passover by Josiah (2 Chr. 35:9).

jeremiah_853.name: Jeremiah
jeremiah_853.description: One of the “greater prophets” of the Old Testament, son of Hilkiah (q.v.), a priest of Anathoth (Jer. 1:1; 32:6). He was called to the prophetical office when still young (1:6), in the thirteenth year of Josiah (B.C. 628). He left his native place, and went to reside in Jerusalem, where he greatly assisted Josiah in…

cyrus_968.name: Cyrus
cyrus_968.description: (Heb. Ko’resh), the celebrated “King of Persia” (Elam) who was conqueror of Babylon, and issued the decree of liberation to the Jews (Ezra 1:1, 2). He was the son of Cambyses, the prince of Persia, and was born about B.C. 599. In the year B.C. 559 he became king of Persia, the kingdom of Media being added to it partly…

joshua_893.name: Joshua
joshua_893.description: The son of Jozadak, and high priest of the Jews under Zerubbabel (Neh. 7:7; 12:1, 7, 10, 26); called Joshua (Hag. 1:1, 12; 2:2, 4; Zech. 3:1, 3, 6, 8, 9).

seraiah_2498.name: Seraiah
seraiah_2498.description: A priest of the days of Jehoiakim (Neh. 12:1, 12).

reelaiah_2406.name: Reelaiah
reelaiah_2406.description: Thunder of the Lord, one of the princes who returned from the Exile (Neh. 7:7); called also Reelaiah (Ezra 2:2).

bilshan_505.name: Bilshan
bilshan_505.description: Son of the tongue; i.e., “eloquent”, a man of some note who returned from the Captivity with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:2; Neh. 7:7).

mispereth_2099.name: Mispereth
mispereth_2099.description: Number, one of the Jews who accompanied Zerubbabel from Babylon (Ezra 2:2); called also Mispereth (Neh. 7:7).

rehum_2413.name: Rehum
rehum_2413.description: One of “the children of the province” who returned from the Captivity (Ezra 2:2); the same as “Nehum” (Neh. 7:7).

pahath-moab_2265.name: Pahath-moab
pahath-moab_2265.description: Governor of Moab, a person whose descendants returned from the Captivity and assisted in rebuilding Jerusalem (Ezra 2:6; 8:4; 10:30).

zattu_2986.name: Zattu
zattu_2986.description: Id., one whose descendants returned from the Captivity with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:8; Neh. 7:13); probably the same as Zatthu.

zaccai_2960.name: Zaccai
zaccai_2960.description: Pure, one whose “sons” returned with Zerubbabel to Jerusalem (Ezra 2:9; Neh. 7:14).

adonikam_100.name: Adonikam
adonikam_100.description: Whom the Lord sets up, one of those “which came with Zerubbabel” (Ezra 2:13). His “children,” or retainers, to the number of 666, came up to Jerusalem (8:13).

kadmiel_1767.name: Kadmiel
kadmiel_1767.description: Before God; i.e., his servant, one of the Levites who returned with Zerubbabel from the Captivity (Neh. 9:4; 10:9; 12:8).

hatita_1455.name: Hatita
hatita_1455.description: Exploration, one of the temple porters or janitors (Ezra 2:42). He returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

ziha_3078.name: Ziha
ziha_3078.description: The name of a family of Nethinim (Ezra 2:43; Neh. 7:46).

hasupha_1451.name: Hasupha
hasupha_1451.description: Uncovered, one of the Nethinim (Ezra 2:43; Neh. 7:46).

tabbaoth_2807.name: Tabbaoth
tabbaoth_2807.description: Impressions; rings, “the children of,” returned from the Captivity (Ezra 2:43).

akkub_182.name: Akkub
akkub_182.description: The head of one of the families of Nethinim (Ezra 2:45).

gahar_1268.name: Gahar
gahar_1268.description: Lurking-place, one of the chief of the Nethinim, whose descendants returned to Jerusalem under Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:47).

mehunim_1985.name: Mehunim
mehunim_1985.description: Habitations, (2 Chr. 26:7; R.V. “Meunim,” Vulg. Ammonitae), a people against whom Uzziah waged a successful war. This word is in Hebrew the plural of Ma’on, and thus denotes the Maonites who inhabited the country on the eastern side of the Wady el-Arabah. They are again mentioned in 1 Chr. 4:41 (R.V.), in the reign of…

harsha_1422.name: Harsha
harsha_1422.description: Worker or enchanter, one of the Nethinim (Ezra 2:52; Neh. 7:54).

barkos_404.name: Barkos
barkos_404.description: Painter, (Ezra 2:53; Neh. 7:55). The father of some of the Nethinim.

sisera_2758.name: Sisera
sisera_2758.description: The ancestor of some of the Nethinim who returned with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:53; Neh. 7:55).

perida_2318.name: Perida
perida_2318.description: One whose descendants returned with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:55); called also Perida (Neh. 7:57).

jaala_661.name: Jaala
jaala_661.description: A wild she-goat, one of the Nethinim, whose descendants returned from the Captivity (Neh. 7:58).

delaiah_1002.name: Delaiah
delaiah_1002.description: The head of one of the bands of exiles that returned under Zerubbabel to Jerusalem (Ezra 2:60; Neh. 7:62).

barzillai_413.name: Barzillai
barzillai_413.description: A priest who married a daughter of the preceding (Ezra 2:61).

henadad_1493.name: Henadad
henadad_1493.description: Favour of Hadad, the name of a Levite after the Captivity (Ezra 3:9).

ahasuerus_117.name: Ahasuerus
ahasuerus_117.description: The son of Darius Hystaspes, the king named in the Book of Esther. He ruled over the kingdoms of Persia, Media, and Babylonia, “from India to Ethiopia.” This was in all probability the Xerxes of profane history, who succeeded his father Darius (B.C. 485). In the LXX. version of the Book of Esther the name Artaxerxes…

artaxerxes_313.name: Artaxerxes
artaxerxes_313.description: The king who obstructed the rebuilding of the temple (Ezra 4:7). He was probably the Smerdis of profane history.

tabeel_2809.name: Tabeel
tabeel_2809.description: A Persian governor of Samaria, who joined others in the attempt to prevent the rebuilding of Jerusalem (Ezra 4:7).

rehum_2414.name: Rehum
rehum_2414.description: The “chancellor” of Artaxerxes, who sought to stir him up against the Jews (Ezra 4:8-24) and prevent the rebuilding of the walls and the temple of Jerusalem.

shimshai_2707.name: Shimshai
shimshai_2707.description: The shining one, or sunny, the secretary of Rehum the chancellor, who took part in opposing the rebuilding of the temple after the Captivity (Ezra 4:8, 9, 17-23).

asnappar_346.name: Asnappar
asnappar_346.description: Probably the same as Assur-bani-pal (Sardanapalos of the Greeks), styled the “great and noble” (Ezra 4:10), was the son and successor (B.C. 668) of Esar-haddon (q.v.). He was “luxurious, ambitious, and cruel, but a magnificent patron of literature.” He formed at Nineveh a library of clay tablets, numbering about…

haggai_1349.name: Haggai
haggai_1349.description: Festive, one of the twelve so-called minor prophets. He was the first of the three (Zechariah, his contemporary, and Malachi, who was about one hundred years later, being the other two) whose ministry belonged to the period of Jewish history which began after the return from captivity in Babylon. Scarcely anything is…

zechariah_3016.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3016.description: A prophet of Judah, the eleventh of the twelve minor prophets. Like Ezekiel, he was of priestly extraction. He describes himself (1:1) as “the son of Berechiah.” In Ezra 5:1 and 6:14 he is called “the son of Iddo,” who was properly his grandfather. His prophetical career began in the second year of Darius (B.C. 520),…

tatnai_2831.name: Tatnai
tatnai_2831.description: Gift, a Persian governor (Heb. pehah, i.e., “satrap;” modern “pasha”) “on this side the river”, i.e., of the whole tract on the west of the Euphrates. This Hebrew title pehah is given to governors of provinces generally. It is given to Nehemiah (5:14) and to Zerubbabel (Hag. 1:1). It is sometimes translated “captain”…

shethar-boznai_2674.name: Shethar-boznai
